rules.rule: Never create a verified facility-to-facility lane solely from network patterns or geographic proximity.
Every verified claim must cite at least one source evidence ID.
A capability does not establish an actual movement of goods.
When destination, volume, contract or eligibility is unspecified, preserve unknown rather than fabricate.
Company evidence must not be embedded in reusable ontology.
Inferred and hypothetical edges remain labeled until reviewed against evidence.
